text:
My daily routine is built around consistency. I wake up at six-thirty each morning, and my first habit is drinking a large glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower, I review my to-do list for the day. By eight, I’m at my desk, focusing on my main work tasks until noon. I usually take a short lunch break, then work for another three hours.

In the late afternoon, I exercise for about forty minutes—either a run or a yoga session. This helps me clear my head after sitting all day. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, or watching a show. I’m in bed by ten-thirty, ready to repeat the same schedule. Following this pattern keeps my days productive and calm.
